beats.text: Want more messages? Some people should think you're ugly.
OkCupid compared women with similar average looks scores.
The ones men disagreed about got more messages. A lot more.
One woman got the lowest rating far more often than another. She still got three times the messages.
One guess: if others aren't into you, I see less competition. Being just cute is a curse.
So don't hide what makes you different. Lean into it.

sources: OkCupid (2011), 'The Mathematics Of Beauty' (OkTrends): the more men disagree about a woman's looks, the more messages; one woman rated lowest 142% more often than another got 3x the messages; competition explanation; 'the curse of being cute'.
